title: Travel v2 Card Schema v0 Fixture Pack

cards.title: Void Shear
cards.publicText: A slanted wake tears across the route, threatening the ship's position and station timing.
cards.gmText: Keep hidden route drift details in GM notes until a consequence is offered.
cards.clearCondition: Navigator succeeds at Thread the Wake or a matching benefit clears progress.

narration.onDeclare: The void shear leans into the wake like a blade.
narration.onHazardCleared: The route snaps back into a clean line.

cards.title: Route Drift
cards.publicText: The ship loses clean alignment with the intended route.
cards.gmText: Offer this as a candidate if Void Shear remains unresolved at round end.
cards.playerSafeSummary: Route alignment worsens unless corrected later.
cards.applyEffectSummary: Record a descriptive route complication for future GM review.

explicitGmApplyEffect.descriptionOnly: Future GM Apply flow may record a route complication; this fixture executes nothing.

narration.onConsequenceCreated: The wake leaves a faint wrongness in the plotted line.

cards.title: Thread the Wake
cards.publicText: Angle the ship through the cleanest break in the pressure seam.
cards.gmText: On failure, offer Route Drift as a pending candidate instead of mutating records automatically.

criticalSuccess.summary: Clear Void Shear and create a Clean Wake Opening.

failure.summary: The hazard remains; GM may offer Route Drift.

criticalFailure.summary: The hazard remains and escalation becomes likely.

narration.onSuccess: The helm finds the seam's quiet spine.

cards.title: Cut the Line Too Close

successBenefits.summary: Clear extra hazard progress or relieve one route pressure.

cards.publicText: Take the dangerous angle before the roll for a stronger route correction.
cards.gmText: Do not allow freeform DC bidding; this fixture uses the fixed +5 option.

narration.onDeclare: The navigator calls the cut before anyone can argue.

cards.title: Clean Wake Opening
cards.stackingPolicy: one pending station benefit per station roll unless a future rule says otherwise
cards.publicText: The next Engineer roll can ride the clean wake for a small DC reduction.
cards.gmText: Session-local only; place in a future pending decisions queue rather than applying automatically.

narration.onBenefitCreated: A clean wake opens behind the navigator's cut.

openingVignette.publicText: A bright pressure seam crosses the plotted route like a luminous scar.
openingVignette.gmText: Use this only as schema fixture content; no runner consumes it yet.

visibleStakes.eventGoal: Cross the seam without losing the route.
visibleStakes.failureResult: The route drifts into uncertain space.
visibleStakes.escalationRisk: Unresolved Void Shear may create Route Drift.

successOutcome.publicText: The seam falls behind in a clean line.

failureOutcome.publicText: The ship exits the seam slightly off course.
failureOutcome.gmText: Offer Route Drift as a candidate; do not apply automatically.

aftermath.publicText: Check pending decisions before moving on.

narration.onDeclare: The crossing begins with all stations braced.
